nodes.title: Modular building assembly (read me first)
widgets_values:
Modular buildings: first build a kit (each piece 4 m wide, one storey 3.5 m tall), then place the kit by rules onto every building's facades - the deliverable is **the kit meshes + an instance table**, not a lump of merged buildings.

Kit (the four left columns): Wall_Plain / Wall_Window / Wall_WindowPair / Wall_Door / Wall_Shopfront / Wall_Balcony / Corner_Pillar / Corner_Bay / Roof_Cornice / Roof_Flat / Roof_Unit / Roof_Tank / Roof_Penthouse (a stair core). Convention: pivot at the midpoint of the bottom edge (rooftop plant: on the roof surface), outer facade facing +Z, wall thickness towards −Z; each piece's primitives have a material attribute (M_Wall / M_Trim / M_Glass / M_Door / M_Metal / M_Roof / M_RoofFlat / M_Sign), exported as glTF material slots; the facade column of the table swaps M_Wall for M_BrickBuff or M_Stucco per building (a material override); UVs are a world-scale box projection (1 UV = 1 m), the same density as the material library (pcg_prod_material_library, one image = 1 m); all seven slots point to the material library's images by relative path in the glb - run the material library first and the kit opens textured.

Assembly (right side):
① On a 4 m grid, rules mark out the footprints of 12 buildings in the four quarters of two crossing 16 m streets (L shapes, slabs, a 14-storey tower, small houses), merged into outlines, each with its own number of floors. The rules wrangle's spare parameters: Layout 1 generates the block instead (lots of 12-20 m frontage with lanes between, Density, Min / Max Floors -- taller toward the crossing --, Seed for another block); Layout 0 is the table above. Buildings of 9+ floors step back: their front row along a street stops 3 floors lower (the Setbacks wrangle's Setback Floors / Setback Min). Layout 1 also lays secondary streets across most quarters (three levels of road: the main streets, secondary streets, lanes).
② The outlines are extruded floor by floor, each side face is a 4 m × 3.5 m slot; slot centre → point (with outward normal).
③ Rules: shopfronts on the main street's ground floors, on the side street only near the crossing (further on, entrances and windows); towers of 9+ floors stand on a two-storey podium (the first floor shopfront too); upper floors take a random piece per "column" (lined up vertically); one balcony style per building (none, scattered on even floors, or bands on every third floor); a cornice ring above the top floor, roofs tiled per cell, rooftop plant, and a stair core on buildings of 8+ floors; pillars where the building turns a corner, round bays on the corners of the crossing; no walls where a set-back row meets the rest. Facade variants: red brick, buff brick (arcades on the main street), painted render (paired windows), modern (curtain walls). AC units on a third of the back windows; pitched roofs (gables, gable ends, dormers) on buildings of up to 4 floors, roof terraces on half the 5-7 floor ones, antennas.
④ Instance table (CSV, with bld / floor / facade columns) + one glb per kit piece (SM_Kit_*.glb) holding LOD0, LOD1 (the small parts stripped, at 40 m) and a convex UCX collision hull, with a .lods.json beside it.
⑤ Preview (right column): Copy to Points by name places the kit back, weathered per building (tint, grime at the foot, curtains, dark and lit windows); the streets get curbs, paving, road paint, manholes, lamps, benches, bins, bus shelters, traffic lights, lane and park trees (Tree Generator with leaf cards) and parked cars; context blocks (whole-bay facade texture, tinted per district, rooftop clutter) and a linear park fill the distance; back yards walled along the streets with sheds and bins; the far trees are impostor cards per camera; an aerial, an eye-level shot, and the aerial again at dusk (the windows and lamps lit).
⑥ The block again under pcg/city as a world: the kit glbs in assets/, a 1024 m tile's instance table, and a World.json (World Manifest) that engine/unreal and engine/unity import; its city key names the facade materials (the importers place the pieces, the facade swap is left to the project).

# ── a generated block (Layout 1)
layout = chi("layout", 0)
sd = chi("seed", 1) + seed * 17          # (seed: the node's rand_seed, e.g. a for-each iteration)
dens = ch("density", 0.85)
fmin = max(1, chi("min_floors", 3))
fmax = min(14, max(fmin, chi("max_floors", 12)))
def hh(a):
    v = np.sin(np.asarray(a, np.float64) * 12.9898 + sd * 78.233 + 0.5) * 43758.5453
    return v - np.floor(v)
ax = np.abs(np.asarray(x))
az = np.abs(np.asarray(z))
q = (np.asarray(x) > 0) * 1 + (np.asarray(z) > 0) * 2
# Layout 2 (a block in a town of the open world): no streets of its own -- the roads are the cells the map's
# road mask covers (ext_road), and nothing is built where ext_off says (outside the town, water)
L2 = layout == 2
er = np.asarray(prim(0, "ext_road", @primnum), np.float64) + 0 * ax
eo = np.asarray(prim(0, "ext_off", @primnum), np.float64) + 0 * ax
so = 0 if L2 else 8
u = np.floor((ax - so) / 4)              # cells out from the street along x
v = np.floor((az - so) / 4)              # and along z
lot = np.full(ax.shape, -1.0)
dl = np.zeros(ax.shape)
lane = np.zeros(ax.shape, bool)
sroad = np.zeros(ax.shape, bool)
for qq in range(4):
    m = q == qq
    # a secondary street across the quarter (three quarters of them): two cells wide, k cells out from the
    # main street; the lots beyond it front it
    has = (hh(qq * 37 + 5) < 0.75) and not L2
    k = 4 + int(hh(qq * 53 + 1) * 3)
    vv = v[m]
    sr = has & (vv >= k) & (vv < k + 2)
    beyond = has & (vv >= k + 2)
    v2 = np.where(beyond, vv - (k + 2), vv)
    off = np.where(beyond, k + 2, 0)
    wu = [3 + int(hh(qq * 101 + k_ * 7.3) * 3) for k_ in range(12)]      # frontages: 3-5 cells
    cu = np.cumsum(wu)
    iu = np.searchsorted(cu, u[m], side='right')
    iv = np.zeros(vv.shape, np.int64)
    lv = np.zeros(vv.shape, bool)
    sv = np.zeros(vv.shape)
    for r_ in (0, 1):
        wv = [3 + int(hh(qq * 211 + r_ * 97 + k_ * 5.1) * 2) for k_ in range(12)]   # depths: 3-4 cells
        cv = np.cumsum(wv)
        mr = beyond == (r_ == 1)
        ivr = np.searchsorted(cv, v2[mr], side='right')
        iv[mr] = ivr + r_ * 100
        lv[mr] = v2[mr] == cv[ivr] - 1
        sv[mr] = np.concatenate([[0], cv])[ivr]
    lot[m] = qq * 1000 + iu * 200 + iv
    lane[m] = ((u[m] == cu[iu] - 1) | lv) & ~sr       # the last cell of a lot: a lane
    sroad[m] = sr
    su = np.concatenate([[0], cu])[iu]
    dl[m] = np.sqrt((8 + 4 * su + 8) ** 2 + (8 + 4 * (sv + off) + 8) ** 2)
# Layout 2 has no crossing between the quarters: a lane along the positive side of each axis keeps them apart
lane = lane | (L2 & (((np.asarray(x) > 0) & (ax < 4)) | ((np.asarray(z) > 0) & (az < 4))))
on = ((ax > so) & (az > so) | L2) & ~lane & ~sroad & (er < 0.5) & (eo < 0.5) & (hh(lot * 0.37 + 0.11) < dens)
# a town block with nowhere to build (all of it road, steep or wet) keeps one small building at its
# middle, so what follows always has a building to work on
if L2 and not on.any():
    on = np.zeros(ax.shape, bool)
    on[int(np.argmin(dl + 1e6 * (er >= 0.5) + 1e3 * (eo >= 0.5)))] = True
near = 1 - np.clip((dl - 14) / 46, 0, 1)
gf = np.clip(np.round(fmin + (fmax - fmin) * near * near * (3 - 2 * near) + (hh(lot * 1.7) - 0.5) * 4), fmin, fmax)
gfa = np.floor(hh(lot * 2.3 + 0.9) * 4)
ids = np.unique(lot[on])
gb = np.where(on, np.searchsorted(ids, lot), -1)
b = where(layout >= 1, gb, b)
f = where(layout >= 1, np.where(on, gf, 0), f)
fa = where(layout >= 1, np.where(on, gfa, 0), fa)
# the road each cell is (0 none; 1 the main street, 2 the side street; Layout 1: 3 a secondary street, 4 a lane)
rd = np.where(np.asarray(az) < 8, 1, np.where(np.asarray(ax) < 8, 2, 0))
rd = np.where((layout == 1) & (rd == 0) & sroad, 3, np.where((layout == 1) & (rd == 0) & lane, 4, rd))
rd = np.where(L2, np.where(er >= 0.5, 1, np.where(lane & (eo < 0.5), 4, 0)), rd)
i@road = rd
i@bld = where(b < 0, -1, b)
i@floors = where(b < 0, 0, f)
i@facade = fa

def cell(x, z, name):
    i = np.floor((np.asarray(x, np.float64) + 52) / 4)
    j = np.floor((np.asarray(z, np.float64) + 44) / 4)
    ok = (i >= 0) & (i < 26) & (j >= 0) & (j < 22)
    v = np.asarray(prim(1, name, np.where(ok, j * 26 + i, 0).astype(np.int64)), np.float64).reshape(ok.shape)
    return np.where(ok, v, -1.0)
sb = chi("setback_floors", 3)          # how many floors lower the front row stops (0 = no setbacks)
smin = chi("setback_min", 9)           # from how many floors a building steps back
x = @P.x
z = @P.z
b = @bld
f = @floors
# the first row of cells along a street (a street cell beside it), the building going on behind it (so it
# has a back part to rise)
fr = 0 * x > 1
for dx, dz in ((4, 0), (-4, 0), (0, 4), (0, -4)):
    r_ = cell(x + dx, z + dz, "road")
    fr = fr | (((r_ >= 1) & (r_ <= 3)) & (cell(x - dx, z - dz, "bld") == b))
ring = (b >= 0) & (f >= smin) & (sb > 0) & fr
i@height = f
i@setback = where(ring, 1, 0)
i@floors = where(ring, f - sb, f)

def cell(x, z, name):
    i = np.floor((np.asarray(x, np.float64) + 52) / 4)
    j = np.floor((np.asarray(z, np.float64) + 44) / 4)
    ok = (i >= 0) & (i < 26) & (j >= 0) & (j < 22)
    v = np.asarray(prim(1, name, np.where(ok, j * 26 + i, 0).astype(np.int64)), np.float64).reshape(ok.shape)
    return np.where(ok, v, -1.0)
fl = floor(@P.y / 3.5)
i@floor = fl
@P.y = fl * 3.5                      # pivot at the midpoint of the bottom edge
t = normalize(cross(set(0, 1, 0), @N))
col = floor(dot(@P, t) / 4 + 0.5)    # which column on the facade (aligned vertically)
face = floor(dot(@N, set(1.3, 0, 2.9)) * 10 + 0.5)
h = rand(col * 7.31 + @bld * 13.7 + face * 0.37)
ox = @P.x + 2 * @N.x                 # 2 m in front of the facade
oz = @P.z + 2 * @N.z
# the street a facade faces: the road class of the cell in front (1 the main street -- or, in a town of the
# open world, any road --, 2 the side street, 3 a secondary street)
rf_ = cell(ox, oz, "road")
main = rf_ == 1
side = rf_ == 2
sec = rf_ == 3
street = main | side | sec
# shops: all along the main street; on the side street only near the crossing (within 24 m of it)
shop = main | (side & (abs(@P.z) < 24))
modern = @facade == 3
# render facades: paired windows; modern ones: curtain walls
win = where(@facade == 2, "Wall_WindowPair", where(modern, "Wall_Curtain", "Wall_Window"))
# one balcony style per building: 0 none, 1 scattered on even floors, 2 bands (every street column, every third floor)
bs = floor(rand(@bld * 5.31 + 1.7) * 3)
bal = street & ~modern & (fl >= 1) & (((bs == 1) & (h > 0.55) & (fl % 2 == 0)) | ((bs == 2) & (fl % 3 == 2)))
# towers (9+ floors) stand on a two-storey podium: the first floor is shopfront too where the ground floor is
podium = (@height >= 9) & (fl == 1) & shop
up_ = where(podium, "Wall_Shopfront", where(bal, "Wall_Balcony",
            where((h < 0.12) & (bs != 2) & ~modern, "Wall_Plain", win)))
# ground floor: shops (behind an arcade on the main street, for the buff-brick buildings); the rest of the
# streets get entrances and windows; the backs doors and plain walls
shopk = where(main & (@facade == 1), "Wall_Arcade", "Wall_Shopfront")
ground = where(shop, shopk, where(street, where(h > 0.6, "Wall_Door", win),
               where(h > 0.78, "Wall_Door", "Wall_Plain")))
# a slot whose front cell is this building and still standing at this floor is inside (where the set-back
# front row meets the rest): no wall
inside = (cell(ox, oz, "bld") == @bld) & (fl < cell(ox, oz, "floors"))
s@name = where(inside, "", where(fl == 0, ground, up_))
i@back = where(street, 0, 1)
@up = set(0, 1, 0)

def cell(x, z, name):
    i = np.floor((np.asarray(x, np.float64) + 52) / 4)
    j = np.floor((np.asarray(z, np.float64) + 44) / 4)
    ok = (i >= 0) & (i < 26) & (j >= 0) & (j < 22)
    v = np.asarray(prim(1, name, np.where(ok, j * 26 + i, 0).astype(np.int64)), np.float64).reshape(ok.shape)
    return np.where(ok, v, -1.0)
# the four cells round this grid point, standing at this storey (built, and tall enough)
y = @P.y + 0.1
def up_(dx, dz):
    return (cell(@P.x + dx, @P.z + dz, "bld") >= 0) & (cell(@P.x + dx, @P.z + dz, "floors") * 3.5 > y)
a = up_(-2, -2)
b = up_(2, -2)
c = up_(-2, 2)
d = up_(2, 2)
n = a * 1 + b * 1 + c * 1 + d * 1
# a corner: one cell (outside corner) or three (inside corner); two side by side are a flat wall
turn = (n == 1) | (n == 3) | ((n == 2) & (a == d))
# one pillar per point (where the set-back front rows meet the rest two masses share a corner)
key = np.round(np.asarray(@P.x) * 10) * 1e7 + np.round(np.asarray(@P.y) * 10) * 1e3 + np.round(np.asarray(@P.z) * 10)
first = np.zeros(len(key), bool)
first[np.unique(key, return_index=True)[1]] = True
i@keep = where(turn & first, 1, 0)
# an outside corner with a street on both its outer sides (the corners on the crossing): a round corner bay
sx_ = where(a | c, -2.0, 2.0)          # the standing cell's side of the point
sz_ = where(a | b, -2.0, 2.0)
def street(dx, dz):
    r_ = cell(@P.x + dx, @P.z + dz, "road")
    return (r_ >= 1) & (r_ <= 3)
cross = (n == 1) & street(-sx_, sz_) & street(sx_, -sz_) & street(-sx_, -sz_)
s@name = where(cross, "Corner_Bay", "Corner_Pillar")
# the building it belongs to (one of the standing cells): its number and facade variant (the bay is rendered)
def pick(name):
    v = [cell(@P.x + dx, @P.z + dz, name) for dx, dz in ((-2, -2), (2, -2), (-2, 2), (2, 2))]
    return where(a, v[0], where(b, v[1], where(c, v[2], v[3])))
i@bld = pick("bld")
i@facade = pick("facade")
# the bay faces out of the corner (diagonally into the crossing)
@N = where(cross, normalize(set(-sx_, 0, -sz_)), set(0, 0, 1))
@up = set(0, 1, 0)
nodes.title: → Corner_Pillar where the building turns a corner; Corner_Bay at the crossing

# the building's long axis (from its cells' extent): the ridge runs along it
b = np.asarray(@bld).reshape(-1).astype(int) + 1
px = np.asarray(@P.x).reshape(-1)
pz = np.asarray(@P.z).reshape(-1)
n_ = b.max() + 1
x0 = np.full(n_, 1e9)
x1 = np.full(n_, -1e9)
z0 = np.full(n_, 1e9)
z1 = np.full(n_, -1e9)
np.minimum.at(x0, b, px)
np.maximum.at(x1, b, px)
np.minimum.at(z0, b, pz)
np.maximum.at(z1, b, pz)
i@axx = where((x1 - x0)[b] >= (z1 - z0)[b], 1, 0)
pitched = @height <= 4
s@name = where(pitched, "Roof_Gable", "Roof_Flat")
@P.y = @floors * 3.5
# the gable piece's ridge is its local X: across the building's axis the piece faces along the other one
@N = where(pitched & (@axx == 0), set(1, 0, 0), set(0, 0, 1))
@up = set(0, 1, 0)

h = rand(@ptnum * 3.17 + 0.5)
big = @floors >= 5
# the stair / lift core: on buildings of 8+ floors, the roof cell nearest the building's middle
b = np.asarray(@bld).reshape(-1).astype(int) + 1
px = np.asarray(@P.x).reshape(-1)
pz = np.asarray(@P.z).reshape(-1)
n_ = np.bincount(b, minlength=b.max() + 1).astype(float)
mx = np.bincount(b, px, b.max() + 1) / np.maximum(n_, 1)
mz = np.bincount(b, pz, b.max() + 1) / np.maximum(n_, 1)
d = (px - mx[b]) ** 2 + (pz - mz[b]) ** 2 + np.asarray(rand(@ptnum * 0.73)).reshape(-1) * 1e-3
dm = np.full(b.max() + 1, 1e9)
np.minimum.at(dm, b, d)
stair = (d == dm[b]) & (np.asarray(@height).reshape(-1) >= 8)
flat = np.asarray(@name).reshape(-1) == "Roof_Flat"
# a roof terrace (decking, planters) over every cell of about half the 5-7 floor buildings; a few antennas
deck = flat & (@height >= 5) & (@height <= 7) & (rand(b * 2.93 + 0.4) < 0.5)
ant = (h >= 0.14) & (h < 0.20)
s@name = where(~flat, "", where(stair, "Roof_Penthouse", where(deck, "Roof_Deck", where(big & (h < 0.035), "Roof_Tank", where(h < 0.14, "Roof_Unit", where(ant, "Roof_Antenna", ""))))))
# random quarter turns, and (plant only) a little slack inside the 4 m cell
a = floor(rand(@ptnum * 1.91) * 4) * 1.5708
@N = set(sin(a), 0, cos(a))
k = where(stair | deck | ant, 0.0, 1.2)
@P.x += (rand(@ptnum * 2.3) - 0.5) * k
@P.z += (rand(@ptnum * 4.1) - 0.5) * k

b = @bld
# every building its own shade (brighter or darker, warmer or cooler)
br = 0.88 + 0.24 * rand(b * 3.7 + 0.1)
hh = rand(b * 5.1 + 0.3) - 0.5
tint = set(br * (1 + 0.10 * hh), br, br * (1 - 0.10 * hh))
# dirt: splashed up the foot of the wall, and a little over the lower floors
grime = (1 - 0.30 * (1 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.6, @hy))) * (0.90 + 0.10 * smoothstep(0.0, 14.0, @hy))
gk = @gk
glass = where(gk < 0.22, set(1.30, 1.15, 0.98), where(gk < 0.40, set(0.55, 0.56, 0.60), set(1, 1, 1)))
@Cd = where(@wk == 1, tint * grime, where(@wk == 2, glass * sqrt(grime), @Cd))
# about a third of the windows lit at dusk, warm, each its own brightness
lit = (@wk == 2) & (gk > 0.45) & (gk < 0.80)
# the shops (ground floor glass) nearly all lit and brighter, the signs glowing
shopl = (@wk == 2) & (@hy < 3.3) & (gk > 0.15)
@emit = set(1.6, 1.05, 0.55) * where(lit, 0.6 + rand(gk * 91.3), 0.0) + set(1.7, 1.3, 0.8) * where(shopl, 1.4, 0.0) + set(1.6, 1.2, 0.7) * where(@wk == 3, 1.1, 0.0)
# the texture shifted per building
@uv = @uv + set(floor(rand(b * 2.3 + 0.7) * 8), floor(rand(b * 7.1 + 0.2) * 8) + rand(b * 1.9))
